question: Does an unsigned (--no-sign-request) read of s3://commoncrawl succeed from inside AWS us-east-1? Documents say no (unsigned access disabled since the 2022 CloudFront change, S3 API for authenticated users only), but the Get Started page keeps a second AWS CLI section that shows --no-sign-request commands and says no AWS account is needed; a probe from outside AWS answered 403.
why: A run cannot start an AWS instance or account; the test needs a caller inside us-east-1 (an operator step) running aws --no-sign-request s3 ls s3://commoncrawl/crawl-data/CC-MAIN-2026-43/ and the same call signed.
